  \caption{\textbf{Stoichiometric invariant audit, curated reference models, and Price-149 strata.} (a) All four networks start from the DeepProZyme draft at threshold $0.50$ for each of $108$ genomes. Added reactions are internal reactions absent from the draft; an added reaction is flux-certified when it carries flux ($|v| > 10^{-6}$) in a parsimonious FBA solution that reaches $v_{\text{bio}} \ge 0.1$ within the network's own reactions. ``Own'' is METEOR's medium (FVA-tight bounds with every non-medium exchange open for uptake); ``audit'' is the Stage 2B minimal medium with the 36-compound ModelSEED supplement, to which the greedy-minimal set of non-medium uptakes needed for growth is added for flux certification because no METEOR or Grow-Support network grows on the strict medium. ``Grows, audit medium'' is measured on the strict audit medium; for the raw draft it is the growth of the profile protocol (uptakes chosen with open exchanges, then limited to $10$). METEOR repairs are archived solutions, not re-runs. GSPA's draft core is seeded from METEOR's archived active set, so the GSPA row compares repair policies on a shared draft core. Dead-end metabolites and elementally unbalanced internal reactions are counted over each method's active network, and unbalanced additions over its added reactions, with one implementation for all rows (\texttt{scripts/meteor\_threshold\_repair.py}). (b) Means over six organisms with curated BiGG models (iML1515, STM\_v1\_0, iYL1228, iJN1463, iYS854, iYO844). (c) Price-149 arms as in Table~6 of the main text, split by the metabolic role of the target reaction. Sources: \texttt{results/pillar2\_invariant\_audit\_summary.tsv} (pipeline P07), \texttt{results/pillar2\_curated6\_gems\_real.tsv}, \texttt{results/pillar2\_price149\_by\_stratum.tsv} (pipeline P08).}
